questions.q: What is the primary function of the Crew Escape System (CES) on ISRO's Human Rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket?
o: To guide the crew module into its designated Low Earth Orbit.
To eject the crew module to safety during launch emergencies.
To assist in docking the crew module with a space station.
To provide thermal shielding during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere.
questions.s:
The Correct answer is To eject the crew module to safety during launch emergencies.

Key Points

  • The Crew Escape System (CES) is a critical safety feature integrated into the ISRO's Human Rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket.
  • Its primary function is to eject the crew module safely in case of any emergency during the launch or ascent phase.
  • The CES ensures the safety of astronauts in scenarios such as rocket malfunctions, anomalies, or other emergencies.
  • This system uses quick-acting escape motors to propel the crew module away from the rocket, thereby ensuring it avoids any potential danger.
  • The CES operates with high precision and is designed to activate within milliseconds of detecting an anomaly.
  • It is an integral part of making the Human Rated LVM3 rocket reliable and meeting international standards for crewed space missions.
  • The system demonstrates ISRO’s commitment to ensuring astronaut safety during its upcoming human spaceflight missions, such as the Gaganyaan Mission.
  • Such systems are standard in human-rated rockets globally, used by agencies like NASA, Roscosmos, and SpaceX.

Additional Information

  • To guide the crew module into its designated Low Earth Orbit
    • This is the function of the main rocket engines, not the Crew Escape System. The HLVM3 rocket is responsible for placing the crew module into the intended orbit.
    • Once in orbit, the crew module performs its mission objectives, such as experiments or docking.
  • To assist in docking the crew module with a space station
    • Docking is a separate operation involving specialized systems like docking mechanisms and does not involve the Crew Escape System.
    • Docking capabilities are used in missions where the crew module needs to connect with a space station or another spacecraft.
  • To provide thermal shielding during re-entry into Earth's atmosphere
    • The responsibility for thermal shielding lies with the heat shield of the crew module, not the Crew Escape System.
    • The heat shield protects astronauts during re-entry by enduring extremely high temperatures generated due to friction with the Earth's atmosphere.

questions.q:
Change the following from active to passive:

They have been neglecting maintenance of the archives for years.
o: Maintenance of the archives had been neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives is being neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives was being neglected by them for years.
Maintenance of the archives has been being neglected by them for years.
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 4.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In this case, the active voice sentence is: "They have been neglecting maintenance of the archives for years."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "maintenance of the archives" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "have been neglecting" to "has been being neglected" (present perfect continuous passive).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
  • Ensure the time phrase "for years" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
Correct Sentence: "Maintenance of the archives has been being neglected by them for years."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "Maintenance of the archives had been neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
  • Option 2: "Maintenance of the archives is being neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
  • Option 3: "Maintenance of the archives was being neglected by them for years." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).

questions.q: Q2. Which of the following best explains the origin of eskers in glaciated landscapes? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन हिमनदीय परिदृश्यों में एस्कर की उत्पत्ति की सबसे अच्छी व्याख्या करता है? [Ssc Phase 13, 26/07/2025]
o: Hills shaped by ice pushing sediments / बर्फ द्वारा तलछट को धकेलने से बनी पहाड़ियाँ
Ridges carved by ice cutting bedrock / बर्फ द्वारा आधारशिला को काटकर बनाई गई लकीरें
Till ridges under stagnant ice / स्थिर बर्फ के नीचे टिल की लकीरें

questions.s: Eskers serve as vital geological evidence indicating the precise direction of ancient glacial meltwater flow. Because they are formed strictly by flowing water rather than solid ice, the sediment contained within an esker is typically "sorted" (heavier stones drop first) and "stratified" (layered), unlike the chaotic, unsorted mixture found in standard glacial till. / एस्कर प्राचीन हिमनद पिघले पानी के प्रवाह की सटीक दिशा को दर्शाने वाले महत्वपूर्ण भूवैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य के रूप में कार्य करते हैं। क्योंकि वे ठोस बर्फ के बजाय कड़ाई से बहते पानी से बनते हैं, एक एस्कर के भीतर निहित तलछट आमतौर पर "कचरा" (sorted) और "स्तरीकृत" (layered) होती है, जो मानक हिमनद टिल में पाए जाने वाले अराजक, बिना छंटे हुए मिश्रण के विपरीत होती है।

questions.q:
If A#B means A is the father of B; A%B means B is the brother of A; A*B means A is the husband of B and A&B means A is the sister of B. In the expression Rugwed # Ved * Priyal & Priya % Tanu, how Priya is related to Ved?

यदि A#B का अर्थ A, B का पिता है; A%B का अर्थ B, A का भाई है; A*B का अर्थ A, B का पति है और A&B का अर्थ A, B की बहन है। अभिव्यक्ति रुग्वेद # वेद* प्रियल & प्रिया % तनु में प्रिया, वेद से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
o: Either sister-in-law or brother-in-lawया तो सिस्टर-इन-लॉ या ब्रदर-इन-लॉ
questions.s:
A#B means A is the father of B

A%B means B is the brother of A

A*B means A is the husband of B

A&B means A is the sister of B

Rugwed # Ved * Priyal & Priya % Tanu

So, it can be concluded that Rugwed is father of Ved.

Ved is husband of Priyal.

Priyal is sister of Priya.

Tanu is brother of Priya.

questions.q: What is the remainder when $(123456789101112\dots 444546)$ is divided by $16$?
questions.s:
Answer is 2.
Dekh bhai! $16 = 2^4$, toh 16 ki divisibility check karne ke liye sirf aakhiri 4 digits chahiye hote hain. Yeh counting series chal rahi hai $44, 45, 46$ tak. Toh last 4 digits hue $4546$. Ab bas $4546 \div 16$ kar. $16 \times 284 = 4544$ hota hai. Remainder kya bacha? 2 bacha. Options eliminate kar aur aage badh!

questions.q: Cheraw, the bamboo dance performed using crossed bamboo sticks, is a folk dance of which state?
questions.s:
The correct answer is Mizoram.

Key Points

  • Cheraw, also known as the bamboo dance, is one of the most famous traditional dances of Mizoram.
  • The dance involves the use of long bamboo sticks, which are held horizontally and tapped rhythmically on the ground by performers.
  • The performers (usually women) move gracefully in and out of the bamboo sticks to the beat of the music without getting their feet caught.
  • This dance holds cultural and religious significance for the Mizo community, as it is often performed during festivals and special occasions, such as weddings or harvest celebrations.
  • The Cheraw dance reflects the rich heritage and traditions of the state of Mizoram.
  • It symbolizes the harmony and coordination between nature and mankind through its intricate movements.
  • Cheraw has gained international fame and is considered a symbol of Mizoram's cultural identity.

Additional Information

  • Meghalaya
    • Meghalaya is known for its rich tribal culture and several traditional dances, such as Wangala Dance, performed by the Garo tribe to celebrate the harvest festival.
    • Another famous dance is the Shad Suk Mynsiem, performed by the Khasi tribe during the spring season.
  • Arunachal Pradesh
    • Arunachal Pradesh is famous for its diverse tribal dances such as Yak Dance, Buiya Dance, and Ajilamu Dance.
    • These dances are often linked to religious rituals and seasonal celebrations.
  • Sikkim
    • Sikkim is known for its traditional dances like the Chu-Faat Dance and Mask Dance, performed during religious festivals.
    • These dances are deeply rooted in Buddhist culture and depict various mythological stories and traditions.

Because they are formed strictly by flowing water rather than solid ice, the sediment contained within an esker is typically "sorted" (heavier stones drop first) and "stratified" (layered), unlike the chaotic, unsorted mixture found in standard glacial till. / एस्कर प्राचीन हिमनद पिघले पानी के प्रवाह की सटीक दिशा को दर्शाने वाले महत्वपूर्ण भूवैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य के रूप में कार्य करते हैं। क्योंकि वे ठोस बर्फ के बजाय कड़ाई से बहते पानी से बनते हैं, एक एस्कर के भीतर निहित तलछट आमतौर पर "कचरा" (sorted) और "स्तरीकृत" (layered) होती है, जो मानक हिमनद टिल में पाए जाने वाले अराजक, बिना छंटे हुए मिश्रण के विपरीत होती है।

questions_hin.s_hi: This is a developing divergent boundary where the African Plate is in the process of splitting into two new plates.

questions_hin.q_hi:
If A#B means A is the father of B; A%B means B is the brother of A; A*B means A is the husband of B and A&B means A is the sister of B. In the expression Rugwed # Ved * Priyal & Priya % Tanu, how Priya is related to Ved?

यदि A#B का अर्थ A, B का पिता है; A%B का अर्थ B, A का भाई है; A*B का अर्थ A, B का पति है और A&B का अर्थ A, B की बहन है। अभिव्यक्ति रुग्वेद # वेद* प्रियल & प्रिया % तनु में प्रिया, वेद से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
o_hi: Either sister-in-law or brother-in-lawया तो सिस्टर-इन-लॉ या ब्रदर-इन-लॉ
questions_hin.s_hi:
A#B means A is the father of B

A%B means B is the brother of A

A*B means A is the husband of B

A&B means A is the sister of B

Rugwed # Ved * Priyal & Priya % Tanu

So, it can be concluded that Rugwed is father of Ved.

Ved is husband of Priyal.

Priyal is sister of Priya.

Tanu is brother of Priya.

questions_hin.q_hi: What is the remainder when $(123456789101112\dots 444546)$ is divided by $16$?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Answer is 2.
Dekh bhai! $16 = 2^4$, toh 16 ki divisibility check karne ke liye sirf aakhiri 4 digits chahiye hote hain. Yeh counting series chal rahi hai $44, 45, 46$ tak. Toh last 4 digits hue $4546$. Ab bas $4546 \div 16$ kar. $16 \times 284 = 4544$ hota hai. Remainder kya bacha? 2 bacha. Options eliminate kar aur aage badh!

questions_hin.q_hi: Cheraw, the bamboo dance performed using crossed bamboo sticks, is a folk dance of which state?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The correct answer is Mizoram.

Key Points

  • Cheraw, also known as the bamboo dance, is one of the most famous traditional dances of Mizoram.
  • The dance involves the use of long bamboo sticks, which are held horizontally and tapped rhythmically on the ground by performers.
  • The performers (usually women) move gracefully in and out of the bamboo sticks to the beat of the music without getting their feet caught.
  • This dance holds cultural and religious significance for the Mizo community, as it is often performed during festivals and special occasions, such as weddings or harvest celebrations.
  • The Cheraw dance reflects the rich heritage and traditions of the state of Mizoram.
  • It symbolizes the harmony and coordination between nature and mankind through its intricate movements.
  • Cheraw has gained international fame and is considered a symbol of Mizoram's cultural identity.

Additional Information

  • Meghalaya
    • Meghalaya is known for its rich tribal culture and several traditional dances, such as Wangala Dance, performed by the Garo tribe to celebrate the harvest festival.
    • Another famous dance is the Shad Suk Mynsiem, performed by the Khasi tribe during the spring season.
  • Arunachal Pradesh
    • Arunachal Pradesh is famous for its diverse tribal dances such as Yak Dance, Buiya Dance, and Ajilamu Dance.
    • These dances are often linked to religious rituals and seasonal celebrations.
  • Sikkim
    • Sikkim is known for its traditional dances like the Chu-Faat Dance and Mask Dance, performed during religious festivals.
    • These dances are deeply rooted in Buddhist culture and depict various mythological stories and traditions.
